exposure: Induction at 40 weeks vs. expectant management
Timing of labor induction (40 weeks vs. expectant management until 41 weeks)
cohort: 60 women with a previous lower segment cesarean section eligible for a trial of labor with singleton fetus without any pregnancy complications
finding: Labor induction at 40 weeks was associated with a significantly higher vaginal birth rate compared to expectant management until 41 weeks.
